chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Muḥammad al-Ḥajjāl, from Thaʿlabah ibn Maymūn, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Hilāl, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about a man who has intercourse with his wife, then performs ghusl before urinating, and then something comes out of him after the ghusl. He said: “There is nothing upon him; indeed that is among what Allah has lifted from him.”

key_terms.الْغُسْلِ: the ritual bath performed for purification
key_terms.لَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no obligation or blame upon him
key_terms.وَضَعَهُ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: Allah has lifted or remitted it from him

ai.seo_question: If something exits after ghusl from janabah before urination, does the ghusl need to be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity after janabah. It states that if a man performs ghusl after intercourse and something exits afterward, there is no liability upon him in this case, as Allah has remitted it from him.
